# Repos created before `!*/` reached the template heal through
# appendMissingLines, which appends at the end of the file - and in a .gitignore
# the last matching rule wins. `!*/` landing after `.sesam/tmp/` would unignore
# the merge driver's plaintext staging dir, so the template re-ignores it with a
# glob as well. Both effects are checked here on a hand-rolled legacy file.

sesam-repo

cp legacy.gitignore .gitignore
exec sesam init --user admin

# The sub-config a legacy repo could never commit is visible now...
mkdir svc
cp token svc/token.txt
exec sesam add --nested svc/token.txt
! exec git check-ignore svc/sesam.yml

# ...and the plaintext the merge driver stages is still ignored, appended
# rules or not.
exec git check-ignore .sesam/tmp/svc/token.txt.ours
exec git check-ignore svc/token.txt

-- legacy.gitignore --
# Generated by sesam init - ignore everything but sesam internals.
*
!.sesam/
!.sesam/**
.sesam/lock
.sesam/tmp/
.sesam/no-git-integration-warning
!sesam.yml
!.gitignore
!.gitattributes
-- token --
s3cr3t
